name: Jean-Pierre Polnareff
creator: kaizen
description:
**Features:**

- Custom model and textures
- Custom animations

- Support for all quality settings
- Dynamic, anime shader
- Custom Voice-over for all languages
- New VFX

- Custom loading screen and in-game icons
- A lot of love for Iggy (Iggy included)
- Custom loading screen and in-game icons


*"Now behold the superb swordsmanship of my stand, Silver Chariot!"*


Fiora has been entirely replaced by Polnareff. It features a full animation overhaul, where he actually uses his stand to fight. Also features two animations that Fiora didn't have originally - homeguard and recall. Also features a full voice-over, new icons, and a VFX change.
Works for EVERY SKIN. No matter which skin you or the enemy picks in champ select, you will always see Polnareff.
